Boston.DramaHorrorSomething Very Bad Is Going to HappenDrag or tap to give a ratingHover and click to give a ratingWhere to Watch Not available in your country?All Seasons Top Cast Camila MorroneRachel, Rachel HarkinAdam DiMarcoNicky, Nicky CunninghamKarla CromeNellTed LevineBorisJennifer Jason LeighVictoriaBlair MacMillanEmma, Wedding GuestMarisa 'Mason' McDonaldCasey, Wedding GuestShaeane JimenezKenzie, Wedding GuestZlatko BuricThe WitnessBrandon KnoxDoug, Wedding GuestDavid HubandArthur, Wedding GuestDebra HaleDiane, Wedding GuestIain StewartCole, Wedding GuestJonathan MasonMike, Wedding GuestKent SheridanUncle Lee, Wedding GuestKevin LiuZander, Wedding Guest Screen RantIt's as if the show collected all the strengths of its predecessors. Even with the minor narrative issues mentioned previously, The Duffer Brothers’ Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen will go down in history as one of the best Netflix horror shows of all time. The PlaylistThere is a difference between suspense and dread. “Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen” is a superb case study in its very specific implications. The TimesWhile those in the market for jump-scares galore may be disappointed by the relative restraint here, the show is a masterclass in slowly building a sense of tension and anxiety while not being afraid to bring in the blood and gore when required. Slant MagazineThere’s plenty of dread-inducing fun to be had in the early episodes, despite their reliance on well-worn genre tropes. But Boston unveils the “very bad” something of the title surprisingly early, and the twist is altogether much sillier—and a bit more contrived—than what the show’s eerie opening stretch suggests. The Daily BeastToo often, the answers it provides are as underwhelming as its action is woefully underlit. TimeThe back half of the season is better overall. The ending isn’t revelatory, in the sense that it doesn’t quite complete Something’s thoughts on matrimony or family or inherited attitudes toward either, but it’s clever and kind of exhilarating. Characters like Nell and Jules gain some depth. There are a few well-executed twists among the many that are easy to anticipate. But those developments create new problems. Wall Street JournalThere’s a lot going on, including a spinning of wheels. It may not be “very bad,” I hasten to add, but the “something very bad” in “Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen” is the pumping of 10 gallons of horror into a 5-gallon vehicle, which never really catches fire and whose wheels fall off.See All 21 Critic Reviews mmberry13I genuinely enjoyed this show. Had me cracking up a lot. Looking forward to seeing where it goes from here. Critical_DonutStarts off really strong with a great sense of tension and unease. I really did feel like something bad was going to happen.
